brief:
Israel and Hamas are adopting a cautious holding pattern as negotiations over a Gaza ceasefire remain deadlocked, Al-Monitor reported. The two sides have shown little willingness to make concessions or escalate pressure, instead marking time as the conflict approaches the one-year anniversary in October.

The stalled talks have left international mediators scrambling for leverage. The Board of Peace faces mounting pressure to broker a breakthrough and deliver tangible results in the Gaza Strip. Neither Israel nor Hamas has signaled readiness to shift position, leaving the diplomatic path uncertain as the months wear on.
dek: As the Israel-Hamas ceasefire approaches the one-year mark in October, the Board of Peace is under pressure to deliver results in the Gaza Strip.
title: Israel, Hamas adopt waiting posture as Gaza ceasefire talks stall
